mprSlabsReinforcement.Description: Analysis, grouping and reinforcement of slabs for specified conditions
mprSlabsReinforcement.FullDescription: Processing both individually selected slabs and all slabs in the view or document. The main reinforcement of the slab can be performed as separate rebars, or area reinforcement. Hole analysis is performed from the slab geometry itself and does not depend on used families. Can work even on an empty template
